access_timestamp_note: Each source record carries its own access_utc. The top-level accessed_utc is the initial multi-source batch; supplemental sources were added later with their own capture times.

sources.title: AstroImageJ: Image Processing and Photometric Extraction for Ultra-Precise Astronomical Light Curves (Expanded Edition)
sources.version_or_commit: 2017 publication / arXiv:1701.04817; exact arXiv revision UNKNOWN
sources.locator: §§III, IV.2, IV.5; Appendices A.6 and B
sources.observed_operation: Read the public expanded paper; it documents staged calibration, interactive multi-aperture photometry, ensemble changes, and that error calculation requires detector gain, dark current, and read noise.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The error model depends on entered detector settings; release/options may differ. No default is presumed to match this archive.
sources.applicability_transferability: Good operational precedent for reproducible time-series reduction and aperture/ensemble sensitivity. Transfer workflow concepts, not parameters or example performance.

sources.title: AstroImageJ Legacy User Guide
sources.locator: Run Multi-Aperture Differential Photometry; Variable Aperture Usage
sources.observed_operation: Read documented target/ensemble count ratios and FWHM-varying aperture operation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Variable sizing depends on FWHM measured within initially defined fixed apertures; those must exceed the largest sequence FWHM. Historical guide notes FWHM overestimation and gives version-specific factors.
sources.applicability_transferability: Only if AIJ was used. Recover archive version/preferences before applying; do not transfer historical factors as defaults.

sources.title: AIJ Release 6.0.11.00
sources.locator: Release changelog, New Features and Bug Fixes
sources.observed_operation: Read official note: optional meridian-flip detection from a changing measurement-table field, faster FITS open, and fixes to Add Data panel, comparison-star labels, plot titling.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Flip detection depends on an available changing field (example PIERSIDE); this is optional. Does not establish the archive's version.
sources.applicability_transferability: Use to show behaviors evolve; reproduce actual version/settings, not current release by default.

sources.title: AIJ Release 5.4.0.00
sources.observed_operation: Read official changelog: beta freeform apertures and fix for BJD timestamps in TESS TICA FFI images.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: BJD fix is explicitly for TESS TICA FFIs; not arbitrary ground FITS or all TESS products.
sources.applicability_transferability: Demonstrates product- and release-specific timing fixes; does not imply this archive had that defect.

sources.title: ccdproc v2.5.1 Reduction Toolbox
sources.locator: Subtract bias and dark; Correct flat; Basic Processing with one command
sources.observed_operation: Read API examples: dark scaling is not default; flat is mean-scaled before division; ccd_process combines overscan/trim/gain/mask/uncertainty/bias/flat.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Dark scaling needs explicit scale=True and appropriate exposure metadata; calibration units must match after gain conversion; flat has optional min_value floor.
sources.applicability_transferability: A transparent later re-reduction option if approved; not known to be used here and not installed/run in this stage.

sources.title: Static and rotating illumination corrections in FORS2@VLT photometry
sources.observed_operation: Read finding that FORS flat illumination had static and orientation-dependent terms; standard-star solutions improved FORS2 flux-scale patterns by about 1–2%.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Specific to FORS/FORS2, filters and era; no evidence teaching camera shares its effect or magnitude.
sources.applicability_transferability: Transfer only the test of residuals versus detector position and camera angle; never transfer correction coefficients.

sources.title: Flattening Scientific CCD Imaging Data with a Dome Flat Field System
sources.observed_operation: Read comparison of dome/twilight/night-sky flats; standard-star observations test known-magnitude reproducibility across the detector.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Camera and illumination setup are study-specific; two flat types agreeing is not sufficient validation.
sources.applicability_transferability: Supports validation from star residuals across detector position rather than visual flat appearance.

sources.title: Optimized temporal binning of comparison star measurements for differential photometry
sources.observed_operation: Read differential extinction/common-mode arguments and the optional target/comparison/test-star procedure, comparison-star binning and RMS diagnostics.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Temporal binning assumes good photometric conditions, low-frequency systematics, no blending; high-frequency cloud trends violate it. Comparison noise adds to target noise.
sources.applicability_transferability: Optional branch only after cadence/noise checks; reported performance does not transfer to these unknown data.

sources.title: TESS Data Products (MAST)
sources.version_or_commit: Live MAST product page observed 2026-10-10; no numbered revision
sources.locator: Product Summary table: calibrated/uncalibrated FFI, target-pixel, light-curve and cotrending products
sources.observed_operation: Read product listing and links to governing TESS product sections.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Availability depends on location, sector, product, cadence and release. No target coordinates were supplied; no lookup was possible.
sources.applicability_transferability: Defines a conditional no-new-observation route. Pixel products help inspect blending/extraction; downloaded curves remain processed products.

sources.title: TESS Mission Overview (MAST)
sources.locator: Mission Overview, Resolution, Capabilities, Data Availability
sources.observed_operation: Read summary of time-series products/FFIs and listed 21 arcsecond per pixel resolution.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Specific sector coverage/cadence requires a coordinate check; coarse pixels may blend sources, and passband/sampling differ.
sources.applicability_transferability: Independent data only if source coverage/separation/cadence suit the question; a simple non-detection may not be diagnostic.

sources.title: TESS Science Data Products Description Document
sources.observed_operation: Read official product specification and its stated scope for SPOC-produced TESS data.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Document instructs users to verify current controlled revision; governs named TESS products, not ground-based FITS.
sources.applicability_transferability: Use for TESS file/time interpretation only if such products are later queried.

sources.title: Lightkurve io.read API reference
sources.version_or_commit: Live unversioned docs (observed 2026-10-10); package version UNKNOWN
sources.observed_operation: Read automatic Kepler/TESS product dispatch; default mask removes severe flags; hard may remove good cadences; hardest is not recommended; default LC flux column is pdcsap_flux.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Exact behavior depends on installed package/product. Masks can remove data; SAP and PDC flux are differently processed.
sources.applicability_transferability: Conditional TESS route: freeze version, product, flux column and mask. Not for local ground-image reduction.

sources.title: Lightkurve v2.5.0 Release Notes
sources.locator: v2.5.0 changes: QLP sectors 56+, FFI cadence handling, time format, FITS/centroid fixes
sources.observed_operation: Read official changelog including product-reader/cadence/time fixes.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: These changes target specific data-product cases; live API docs are not pinned to v2.5.0.
sources.applicability_transferability: Freeze software version and product for any later reproduction; shows mission data tooling evolves.

sources.title: Achieving Better Than 1 Minute Accuracy in Heliocentric and Barycentric Julian Dates
sources.observed_operation: Read warning that JD/BJD/HJD need explicit time standards and recommendation to report site arrival time with BJD_TDB.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Accurate conversion depends on time standard, target coordinates, site location and clock/site-arrival metadata; required precision sets corrections.
sources.applicability_transferability: Preserve native time keyword and exposure start/mid/end. No conversion was run because required metadata are absent.

sources.title: Astropy LombScargle API
sources.version_or_commit: Astropy docs v8.0.1 stable at access
sources.observed_operation: Read current frequency-grid choices and statement that FAP methods approximate a Gaussian-noise, non-varying null.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: FAP estimates are approximate under stated null; they do not absorb correlated systematics or determine aliases.
sources.applicability_transferability: Later exploratory period search only after reduction/timing validation; not evidence about this case.

sources.title: Understanding the Lomb–Scargle Periodogram
sources.observed_operation: Read uneven-sampling examples and warning that a largest peak can be an alias under structured observing windows.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Methods paper, not analysis of this archive; significance depends on sampling and noise model.
sources.applicability_transferability: Require window/alias checks and independent repeatability before any astrophysical period interpretation.

sources.title: The effect of red noise on planetary transit detection
sources.observed_operation: Read the primary paper's covariance treatment and OGLE examples; neighboring measurements can be correlated and uncertainty need not decrease as n^-1/2.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The quantitative model and transit thresholds are specific to OGLE-style transit data; actual covariance must be measured or modeled for this archive.
sources.applicability_transferability: Supports checking residual correlation and RMS-versus-timescale before using iid errors or false-alarm estimates; transfer this diagnostic, not its thresholds.

sources.title: Assessing the statistical significance of periodogram peaks
sources.locator: Abstract; extreme-value method for maxima in periodogram searches
sources.observed_operation: Read the primary paper abstract describing tested analytic estimates and an upper bound for false-alarm probability of searched periodogram peaks.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: A peak-level frequency-search correction is distinct from correction across many stars, apertures, reductions, or post-selected candidates; model assumptions and frequency limits must be stated.
sources.applicability_transferability: Supports accounting for the search window, while requiring the later study to reproduce its entire candidate-selection process and correlated-noise controls.

sources.title: AAVSO Guide to CCD/CMOS Photometry with Monochrome Cameras
sources.version_or_commit: Version 1.0 (July 2022); current hosted PDF served from AAVSO in 2026
sources.locator: §§2.1.2-2.1.7 (background, repeatability, frame position, color); Ch. 4 (calibration/acquisition); §§5.1-5.7 (differential/check/comparison); §§7.2-7.4 (standards/root cause); §8.2 (time/cadence)
sources.observed_operation: Read the version page, background/position chapters, calibration, saturation/airmass, comparison/check-star, and root-cause guidance. The guide relates light pollution to sky background/noise, edge position to vignetting/optical effects, recommends comparison/check stars and standard fields, and records major camera-technology/version history.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Guidance is for beginner/intermediate CCD/monochrome-CMOS photometry. It states calibration images should match science temperature and CMOS gain/offset/binning/readout; scaled and unscaled dark methods should not be mixed in one session. Camera-specific numeric examples are not universal defaults.
sources.applicability_transferability: Especially relevant to teaching-telescope controls and standard-star tests. Transfer the checks, not frame counts, saturation limits, filter transformations, or a specific camera's results.

sources.title: AIJ Release 6.0.10.00
sources.locator: BJD conversion API and Multi-plot latitude/longitude keyword options
sources.observed_operation: Read official release notes: BJD conversion API changed to process table JD columns in one operation; latitude/longitude can be read from headers for BJD conversion and airmass.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The observatory latitude/longitude automation requires the corresponding header keywords; it does not remove the need to verify site and clock metadata. The change is AIJ 6.0.10-specific.
sources.applicability_transferability: Supports explicit validation of site coordinates in any historical timing conversion. Does not establish which AIJ release or metadata the archive used.

claim_index.claim: Orientation may interact with detector position/illumination; test, do not assume.
AIJ operations, error model, and version history.
Differential photometry, extinction, comparison noise, and optional binning conditions.
Conditional independent archive path and product/quality limits.
Correlated noise can make white-noise significance optimistic; check dependence by timescale.
Periodogram peak significance must reflect the searched frequency range and candidate-selection process.
Background, frame position, calibration settings, saturation, comparison/check stars, and post-change quality review have practical photometry guidance.
AIJ timing/airmass conversion depends on release and observatory coordinate metadata.
